title: {{send_tool}} — output
description: Output schema for the SOX send operation. Returned as soon as the backing store durably accepts the message. A successful response guarantees the message is immediately visible to all matching watch loops and subsequent recv calls (backing-store send-atomicity contract). Normative reference: spec/ports/backing-store.md §2.1 and spec/protocol.md.

sent_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating-point) at which the backing store accepted the message. Retained for backward compatibility; seq is the authoritative ordering key within a channel.

message_id.description: Backing-store-assigned unique identifier for the message just sent. Use this as the reply_to value for threaded replies, or as the reference in channels__ack calls.

seq.description: Per-channel monotone sequence number assigned to this message. Starts at 1 for each channel. Use as the 'since' cursor in replay queries.

backpressure.description: Backpressure signal for the target channel's recipient queue. Always present regardless of the channel's backpressure_mode. Senders SHOULD use this to self-throttle in advisory mode. In enforced mode (backpressure_mode: enforced), the server returns BACKPRESSURE_OVER_LIMIT error instead of a successful response when state is 'over'.

queue_depth.description: Current number of unprocessed messages in the recipient's pending queue for this channel.

threshold.description: The absolute message count at which the queue is considered at capacity. Default: 1000. Per-channel override is configurable.

state.description: Server-computed backpressure state. 'ok': queue_depth < threshold * 0.8. 'warn': queue_depth >= threshold * 0.8 and < threshold. 'over': queue_depth >= threshold. Thresholds are server-computed; senders receive consistent values across all concurrent sends.
